items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: "So Charlie said, 'Well, they're in the band, ain't they, fool?'"

ctx.x: Yeah. Well, you weren't the first Black guy to play on the band?
No, no, Peanuts Holland was the first, I guess. I guess, I don't know. Maybe he had somebody Black before that. I don't know..
I don't know. But then, of course, he had Trummy...
